dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region features several prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures characterized by irregular, high-contrast perimeters. These structures exhibit a sharp, non-uniform gradient transition from the dark exterior base to a light-colored, high-intensity interior lumen.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A moderate spatial density of solid, high-intensity light-gray clusters is present, particularly in the anterior region. These clusters appear as asymmetrical blobs with uniform pixel concentration and lack the internal gradient seen in the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an acute triangular geometric relationship. A secondary, near-linear alignment is observed among four smaller high-intensity blobs extending towards the posterior extremity.
